title: ClimatView 地点別データ・グラフ — Chiang Mai (station 48327), Thailand
publisher: Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA), ClimatView monthly statistics
claims: The ClimatView station page identifies Chiang Mai, Thailand (station 48327) at 18.77 degrees north, 98.97 degrees east and 313 m elevation.
The same page states that its normal values are calculated from the 30-year average of 1991-2020 data.
For November the page gives a normal monthly mean temperature of 24.7 degrees Celsius.
For November the page gives a normal monthly precipitation of 29.8 millimetres.
For December the page gives a normal monthly mean temperature of 22.5 degrees Celsius and a normal monthly precipitation of 10.0 millimetres; for January, 22.3 degrees Celsius and 11.3 millimetres.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取 JMA ClimatView 站点页；页内标注「平年値は1991-2020年の30年間のデータの平均をもとに算出しています」。11 月平年值为月平均气温 24.7 °C、月降水量 29.8 mm。该页不提供相对湿度。
